name: Bright Angel
science_question: The light-toned Bright Angel rocks sit in the channel below the Margin unit. Are they younger than the Margin unit, as Jones et al. suggest, and where exactly is the contact?
tasks: Photograph the contact between the light-toned outcrop and the Margin unit.
Photograph the layering in one slab with a scale bar in the frame.
Look for light-toned, erosion-resistant veins or centimetre-size nodules and note where they occur.

photos.caption: Light-toned, flat-lying rock below the sand of the Neretva Vallis channel at Bright Angel.
Close view of light-toned, finely layered rock slabs at Bright Angel.
